title: A Day on Venus Is Longer Than a Year! 🤯
lines: A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Venus spins once in about 243 Earth days.
But it orbits the Sun in just 225 days.
description: Venus takes longer to rotate once than to orbit the Sun. #shorts #space #venus

title: Why Does Saturn Float? 🪐
lines: Saturn is less dense than water.
Its average density is about 0.69 grams per cubic centimeter.
In an impossibly huge ocean, Saturn would float.
But there is no ocean big enough!
description: Saturn's average density is lower than water. #shorts #saturn #space
